// profiles: One entry per profile; the key is its name, and the order here is the order in the sidebar's switch. Copy this file to profiles.json and make it yours. Check it with: python3 mods/t3-context/profiles.py check

work.label: Work
work.// badge, color: The text and theme colour of the account chips; badge defaults to the label.
work.// machines: Machines (hc machine ls) that are this profile's alone. A machine in no profile is shared: its spaces go by folder.
work.// folders: On a shared machine: folders whose spaces are this profile's.
work.// coordinator: The folder (in the app home, or absolute) whose CLAUDE.md is this profile's coordinator's instructions.
work.// agents: reviewer: the agent that reviews for this profile (its program); leave it out for no reviewer. hc starts it through the template whose command runs it (hc templates). forbidden: programs an agent of this profile must not start.
work.// accounts: provider -> its settings. A secret is {"env": "NAME"} (a variable of your login shell or ~/.profile) or {"command": [...]}, never the value.

accounts.// claude: null: Claude Code's default config dir (~/.claude).
